item.title: Open-weight models keep getting smaller and faster
item.description: New open-weight models with around a billion parameters can now run on an ordinary laptop. Researchers say the smaller models are good enough for summarising, sorting, and answering questions without sending data to a server.

item.title: RSS feeds are still alive, quietly
item.description: RSS never really died. Thousands of newspapers, blogs, and government sites still publish feeds, and readers that use them need no account, no tracking, and no feed algorithm.
